data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Bulldog Investors' most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in TRC, NWFL, and ELME.

One recent public-record signal: TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier, up 71.7% year over year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm).

I publish Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only, never issuer-paid. May I send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot?

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
